title: At Least the Fish Know
description: The journalist Linorea seems troubled by something...

mainQuestExcel.title: At Least the Fish Know
mainQuestExcel.description: The journalist Linorea seems troubled by something...

dialogs.text: The number of fish in here has decreased again. Are the Mekafish acting up again?
I need to put the fry out into deeper waters... Ugh, why did my divesuit have to give out now?
What are you up to?
Hello there. Pleased to meet you. I'm Linorea, a journalist specializing in reporting on environmental issues. I'm... putting fish fry into these waters.
A journalist?
That's right, the sort you know of. But I'm not like those who publish gossip about public figures or regurgitate boring news all day.
What I'm concerned about is an ongoing, serious issue that threatens the safety of the general public here in the Court of Fontaine.
And that is why I am here putting fry out into the waters.
Do you know about Mekafish?
Never heard of them.
Are they a species unique to the Court of Fontaine?
And why are you doing that, exactly?
The number of fish in here has decreased again. Are the Mekafish acting up again?
I need to put the fry out into deeper waters... Ugh, why did my divesuit have to give out now?
What are you up to?
Hello there. Pleased to meet you. I'm Linorea, a journalist specializing in reporting on environmental issues. I'm... putting fish fry into these waters.
Wait, you look familiar. Weren't you with Semaine when we last saw him, Linorea?
You must be Semaine's...
Wait, you know Semaine? Are you... Oh, were you the ones who helped him bring those gifts? Thank you so much.
Semaine only told me about that after I'd finished watching the opera and returned home previously. Honestly, I've been looking to invite you for a meal at my place.
I didn't think I would meet you here... but this is really bad timing...
You just said that you're throwing fry into the water, right?
And why are you doing that, exactly?
Do you know about Mekafish?
Never heard of them.
Are they a species unique to the Court of Fontaine?
I'll go check out the deep waters.
I'm counting on you. Unfortunately, given the state of my divesuit... that's all I can do right now.
I'll check out the shallow waters.
I'm counting on you. Unfortunately, given the state of my divesuit... that's all I can do right now.
Hmph. These Mekafish are clockwork machines created by the Fontaine Research Institute. They're the ones ruining the waters in the Court of Fontaine!
A water body usually has a balanced ecosystem where various fish and other creatures live together within a stable order. This order allows them to grow and thrive.
Even though this order is sometimes disrupted when, say, people come to fish, when invasive species are introduced...
Sometimes, the weather also shifts, causing some fish to leave these waters...
There is a subtle balance being maintained within this water body, on the whole.
But everything turned into a complete mess ever since those idiots at the Institute created the Mekafish!
They promote them as tools that can keep the waters clean by removing trash and other assorted items in the water. Nothing else, they say!
And at first, that is what they did, and we believed the nonsense they fed us.
But after a while, we received reports that fish populations were constantly decreasing in water bodies where Mekafish were deployed.
That's when we realized that the Mekafish labeled other fish as "trash" when doing their cleanup work!
So that's how they define "clean water"...
Faced with intense resistance from us, those researchers deactivated the Mekafish and prepared for their retrieval.
But as they were preparing to do so, there was a huge explosion at the Institute...
After that, some of those originally deactivated Mekafish reactivated themselves, and began attacking fish even more fiercely.
Several of my colleagues and I agreed that this could not go on. If the Mekafish are left to run amok, they will bring calamity upon our aquatic ecosystem!
So, with the help of several environmentalists, we planned to place suitable fish fry in various water bodies and cultivate new batches of fish through artificial means.
On the other hand, we hired adventurers to constantly destroy and retrieve Mekafish, thus forming a two-pronged approach to protecting the ecology of our waters.
An impressive ambition.
Thank you for your praise — I know this doesn't sound like something a journalist should be doing.
However, I believe that our duty to go to the frontline and do some practical work comes before writing essays and articles.
Only by doing frontline work can we obtain the truest and most accurate information, with which the best report can be written.
Wow, this reporter's really impressive...
What can I do to help?
Hmm? Well, thanks for your kind offer. My divesuit is currently non-functional, so I can't go underwater to distribute fish fry.
If you don't mind, could you go down and do it for me? Shallow or deep zones, doesn't matter.
An admirable plan.
Everything that's not water is considered trash...
These Mekafish... What a pain!
What's happened?
I did, but it fell apart quite quickly afterward.
The Mekafish in this area have gone hog-wild, for... whatever reason.
No sooner did I try to place the fish fry in their vicinity that they swarmed over, gobbling the fry up non-stop.
Some of them even lunged at me to get the few fry hanging off my divesuit...
I mean, I know they won't attack me... But that was still terrifying.
I struggled, flailing in the water...
I don't know how, but that tore another large hole in my divesuit somewhere... Fortunately, I was close enough to the shore that getting back up ultimately proved possible.
As things stand, however, I won't be able to distribute the fry for the time being.
Traveler, could you help me do it once again? Shallow or deep zones, doesn't matter.
Have you fixed your divesuit?

flow.stepDescription: Go to the deep waters to place the fish fry

dialogs.text: Have you helped me place the fry into the water? Given the state of my divesuit, I can only count on you at the moment.
Have you helped me place the fry into the water?
I have.
Thanks so much. Once I fix my divesuit, I'll come back and continue my work.
I hope those fish will grow up safely.
Don't worry, I've prepared many species of fry for all sorts of waters and different environments.
The batch that you placed earlier was chosen specifically for this region.
I'll place a few more batches, and then the adventurers we hired will come over and clear out the Mekafish in the area.
I believe that this batch will grow up healthy and restore the ecological environment in this area.
Once enough water bodies have recovered, I'll write a long-form report. I'll tell the public what the Fontaine Research Institute has done to our natural environment.
Just you wait, Damestier. I won't let you stop me again!
